summary: Planet Image International Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated, China-based computer peripheral maker listed on NYSE (file 001-41928), furnished a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, covering its interim period ended June 30, 2026. The exhibit is a routine semi-annual financial report with XBRL tags spanning revenue by segment (online retail, ODM, dealers), geography (Asia, Europe, North America), gubernatorial loan guarantees, and a one-year loan agreement disclosed as a subsequent event on July 31, 2026. No special-situation transaction—merger, tender, activist, spin-off, restructuring, or capital return—is disclosed; terms, recommendation, and advisors are absent. Watch for follow-on material-event 6-Ks, not this periodic filing.
